pr_summary: Fix WebGPU shader code bugs in WGSL shader files. The patch corrects variable references in bumpFragment.fx (use fragmentInputs.vDetailUV, fragmentInputs.vBumpUV instead of vDetailUV, vBumpUV), depthPrePass.fx (use fragmentOutputs.color and return fragmentOutputs instead of gl_FragColor and bare return), morphTargetsVertex.fx (properly construct vec4f for tangent update), oitFragment.fx (change 'uvar' to 'var' for halfFloat variable), and default.fragment.fx (fix fragmentInputs.vDecalUV references and refraction matrix calculation).
environment_management: npm workspaces with lerna and nx monorepo management
patch_file_cues: WebGPU-specific shader code (fragmentInputs, fragmentOutputs, vec2f, vec3f, vec4f types)
Shader include files in ShadersInclude subdirectory
test_file_cues: Jest configuration with multiple projects (unit, visualization, integration, performance, interactions)
platform_constraint_evidence: package.json specifies Node.js runtime with no platform restrictions
CI workflows use standard npm/node tooling
No Windows-specific APIs or MSVC dependencies in touched files
WGSL shader files are platform-agnostic GPU code
Jest and Playwright test frameworks are cross-platform
No .sln, .vcxproj, Xcode projects, or platform-specific build targets
notes: Babylon.js is a TypeScript/JavaScript 3D rendering engine using a monorepo structure managed by npm workspaces, lerna, and nx. The fix targets WebGPU WGSL shader files which are text-based shader source files. The build system uses TypeScript compilation and webpack bundling. Tests use Jest for unit tests and Playwright for visualization tests. The project is fully cross-platform and runs on Linux without issues. The touched .fx files are WGSL shader source files (not Windows-specific) that get processed during the build.
